page: Microsoft Azure M16bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz, this instance features 16 vCPUs (8 physical cores with hyper-threading) and 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. The architecture includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix math. It is equipped with a 410 GB local disk and supports Premium Storage for high-performance block storage workloads.

Benchmark data highlights strong single-core capabilities, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores reaching the top 10% tier. Single-threaded gzip compression and text generation for small LLM models (135M) also demonstrate strong performance in the top 25% tier. Other compute, memory bandwidth, and database operations, including Redis SET operations and static web serving, perform within the average range.

The M16bds_v3 offers a balanced profile for memory-intensive applications requiring dedicated CPU resources and fast local storage without the overhead of a GPU. Its hardware configuration and high-frequency Intel processor make it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads like relational databases, in-memory caching, text processing, and software compilation.
